command:
set -u
export TMPDIR=/tmp
export ANDROID_HOME=/Users/kelvin/Library/Android/sdk
export PATH="$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools:$ANDROID_HOME/emulator:$PATH"
export CI=1
export NO_COLOR=1

failures=0
LAST_STATUS=0
emulator_pid=""

initial_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD) || exit 2
initial_tree=$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}') || exit 2
initial_patch_sha=$(git diff --binary | shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}')
initial_diff_paths=$(git diff --name-only | sort)
printf 'SOURCE_HEAD_INITIAL=%s\n' "$initial_head"
printf 'SOURCE_TREE_INITIAL=%s\n' "$initial_tree"
printf 'SOURCE_PATCH_SHA256_INITIAL=%s\n' "$initial_patch_sha"
printf 'SOURCE_DIFF_PATHS_INITIAL:\n%s\n' "$initial_diff_paths"
printf 'TEMP_ROOT=%s\n' "$TMPDIR"
git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all

run_step() {
  local step_name="$1"
  shift
  printf '\n=== STEP START: %s ===\n' "$step_name"
  "$@"
  LAST_STATUS=$?
  printf '\n=== STEP END: %s EXIT_STATUS=%s ===\n' "$step_name" "$LAST_STATUS"
  if [ "$LAST_STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
    failures=$((failures + 1))
  fi
  return 0
}

shutdown_emulator() {
  if [ -z "$emulator_pid" ]; then
    return 0
  fi
  printf '\n=== EMULATOR SHUTDOWN START ===\n'
  "$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb" -s emulator-5554 emu kill >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  for ((attempt=1; attempt<=30; attempt++)); do
    if ! kill -0 "$emulator_pid" 2>/dev/null; then
      break
    fi
    sleep 1
  done
  if kill -0 "$emulator_pid" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill -TERM "$emulator_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  wait "$emulator_pid" >/dev/null 2>&1
  local wait_status=$?
  printf 'EMULATOR_PROCESS_EXIT_STATUS=%s\n' "$wait_status"
  emulator_pid=""
  printf '=== EMULATOR SHUTDOWN END ===\n'
  return 0
}

cleanup_on_exit() {
  shutdown_emulator
}
trap cleanup_on_exit EXIT

run_step "full_vitest_suite" npm test -- --run
full_test_status=$LAST_STATUS

run_step "production_build" npm run build
build_status=$LAST_STATUS

sync_status=125
if [ "$build_status" -eq 0 ]; then
  run_step "android_asset_copy" env PATH="/opt/homebrew/Cellar/node/24.9.0/bin:$PATH" ./node_modules/.bin/cap copy android
  sync_status=$LAST_STATUS
else
  printf '\n=== STEP SKIPPED: android_asset_copy REQUIRES production_build PASS ===\n'
  failures=$((failures + 1))
fi

android_status=125
if [ "$build_status" -eq 0 ] && [ "$sync_status" -eq 0 ]; then
  printf '\n=== ANDROID EMULATOR START: Wave11_Android35 ===\n'
  "$ANDROID_HOME/emulator/emulator" -avd Wave11_Android35 -port 5554 -no-window -no-audio -no-boot-anim -no-snapshot &
  emulator_pid=$!
  printf 'EMULATOR_PID=%s\n' "$emulator_pid"

  boot_ready=0
  for ((attempt=1; attempt<=180; attempt++)); do
    device_state=$("$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb" -s emulator-5554 get-state 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ "$device_state" = "device" ]; then
      boot_state=$("$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb" -s emulator-5554 shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r\n' || true)
      if [ "$boot_state" = "1" ]; then
        boot_ready=1
        break
      fi
    fi
    sleep 2
  done

  if [ "$boot_ready" -eq 1 ]; then
    export ANDROID_SERIAL=emulator-5554
    printf 'ANDROID_BOOT_STATUS=READY\n'
    run_step "android_native_process_restart_journey" npm run test:android
    android_status=$LAST_STATUS
  else
    printf 'ANDROID_BOOT_STATUS=FAILED_OR_TIMEOUT\n'
    android_status=1
    failures=$((failures + 1))
  fi
  shutdown_emulator
else
  printf '\n=== STEP SKIPPED: android_native_process_restart_journey REQUIRES production_build AND android_asset_copy PASS ===\n'
  failures=$((failures + 1))
fi

printf '\nFULL_VITEST_EXIT_STATUS=%s\n' "$full_test_status"
printf 'PRODUCTION_BUILD_EXIT_STATUS=%s\n' "$build_status"
printf 'ANDROID_ASSET_COPY_EXIT_STATUS=%s\n' "$sync_status"
printf 'ANDROID_NATIVE_JOURNEY_EXIT_STATUS=%s\n' "$android_status"

final_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD) || exit 2
final_tree=$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}') || exit 2
final_patch_sha=$(git diff --binary | shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}')
final_diff_paths=$(git diff --name-only | sort)
printf 'SOURCE_HEAD_FINAL=%s\n' "$final_head"
printf 'SOURCE_TREE_FINAL=%s\n' "$final_tree"
printf 'SOURCE_PATCH_SHA256_FINAL=%s\n' "$final_patch_sha"
printf 'SOURCE_DIFF_PATHS_FINAL:\n%s\n' "$final_diff_paths"
git diff --check
diff_check_status=$?
printf 'GIT_DIFF_CHECK_EXIT_STATUS=%s\n' "$diff_check_status"
if [ "$diff_check_status" -ne 0 ]; then
  failures=$((failures + 1))
fi
git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all

if [ "$final_head" != "$initial_head" ] || [ "$final_tree" != "$initial_tree" ] || [ "$final_patch_sha" != "$initial_patch_sha" ] || [ "$final_diff_paths" != "$initial_diff_paths" ]; then
  printf 'SOURCE_IDENTITY_STABILITY=FAIL\n'
  failures=$((failures + 1))
else
  printf 'SOURCE_IDENTITY_STABILITY=PASS\n'
fi

printf 'OVERALL_FAILURE_COUNT=%s\n' "$failures"
if [ "$failures" -eq 0 ]; then
  exit 0
fi
exit 1
